newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa stocks end down, industrials slip.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa stocks end down, industrials slip.

text.p: 1415 GMT - South African stocks end down with industrials slipping slightly, but dealers say market just winding down for hoiday season. Golds ease slightly as bullion price steady. Some basket-trading but volumes light and prices seen continuing in same vein to New Year.
* The all-share index dips 4.0 points to 6,536.4 as industrials shed 26.8 points to 7,769.0. Golds dip 8.8 points to 1,493.1.
* De Beers puts on 300 cents to 133.00 rand, Anglos adds 325 cents to 247.25 rand and Richemont loses 50 cents to 65.25 rand.
